meta.project: ERP Foundation Security, Common Utils, File, Master Data, and Notifications Backend

product_overview: A backend-only ERP foundation platform providing centralized authentication, authorization, master data, file handling, shared configurations, and notification services. It exposes REST APIs for administration, runtime lookups, secure file access, and cross-module operational support.
core_goals: Provide stateless JWT-based authentication with secure account lifecycle management
Enable role-based access control through modules, pages, permissions, roles, and user assignments
Support reusable runtime configuration, lookup, and master-data management across modules
Allow secure file upload, categorization, access-token-based download, and lifecycle control
Deliver configurable notification dispatching with templates, channels, and audit logs

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Allows users to log in, refresh access, log out, request password resets, reset passwords, and activate accounts.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/security/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with access and refresh tokens -> POST /api/v1/security/auth/refresh with refresh token -> Receive 200 with rotated tokens
POST /api/v1/security/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> POST /api/v1/security/auth/forgot-password with email -> Receive neutral 200 response

POST /api/v1/security/auth/logout with valid Bearer token -> Receive 204 no content and refresh token invalidation -> POST /api/v1/security/auth/refresh with the same refresh token -> Receive 401 or token rejection
POST /api/v1/security/auth/activate with valid activation code -> Receive 200 activation success -> POST /api/v1/security/auth/login with activated credentials -> Receive 200 with tokens

POST /api/v1/security/auth/reset-password with invalid or expired reset code -> Receive 400 validation error or 401 rejection -> POST /api/v1/security/auth/login with old password -> Receive 401 unauthorized response

features.name: Security Lookups and Self Info
features.description: Provides authenticated access to security lookup values and the current user's granted dashboard modules.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/security/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/v1/security/lookups/{lookupKey} with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with lookup values
POST /api/v1/security/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/v1/security/me/modules with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with the user's granted modules
GET /api/v1/security/lookups/{lookupKey} without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response
GET /api/v1/security/lookups/{unknownLookupKey} with Bearer token -> Receive 404 not found response

features.name: Module Management (Tier-1 grantable units)
features.description: Manages top-level security modules that can be granted to roles and later used for access control.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/security/modules with valid module data -> Receive 201 created with module details -> GET /api/v1/security/modules/{id} -> Receive 200 with the created module
POST /api/v1/security/modules/search with matching filters -> Receive 200 with paginated module results
PUT /api/v1/security/modules/{id} with valid updates -> Receive 200 updated module -> GET /api/v1/security/modules/{id} -> Receive updated values
DELETE /api/v1/security/modules/{id} for an existing module -> Receive 204 no content and soft deactivation -> GET /api/v1/security/modules/{id} -> Receive 404 or inactive record behavior
POST /api/v1/security/modules with duplicate or invalid code -> Receive 400 validation error or conflict response

features.name: Page Registry (Tier-2 screens)
features.description: Manages screen/page registry entries and automatically generates permissions when pages are created.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/security/pages with valid page data -> Receive 201 created page -> GET /api/v1/security/permissions -> Receive the auto-generated permission in the list
POST /api/v1/security/pages/search with filters -> Receive 200 with paginated page results
PUT /api/v1/security/pages/{id} with valid updates -> Receive 200 updated page -> GET /api/v1/security/pages/{id} -> Receive updated page details
DELETE /api/v1/security/pages/{id} for an existing page -> Receive 204 no content and soft deactivation
POST /api/v1/security/pages with invalid module reference or malformed data -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Permissions
features.description: Lists permissions for role-granting workflows and supports filtering by page, module, and permission type.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/security/permissions?pageFk={pageFk}&permissionType={permissionType}&moduleFk={moduleFk}&page=0&size=20 with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with filtered permissions
GET /api/v1/security/permissions?page=0&size=20 with Bearer token and no filters -> Receive 200 with paginated permission list
GET /api/v1/security/permissions without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response
GET /api/v1/security/permissions with invalid page or size values -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: Role Management
features.description: Creates and maintains roles, and grants or revokes Tier-1 modules and Tier-2 permissions for access control.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/security/roles with valid role data -> Receive 201 created role -> POST /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/modules with a module id -> Receive 204 grant success -> GET /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/modules -> Receive 200 with granted modules
POST /api/v1/security/roles/search with search criteria -> Receive 200 with paginated role results
POST /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/permissions with a permission id -> Receive 204 grant success -> GET /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/permissions -> Receive 200 with granted permissions
DELETE /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/modules/{moduleId} for an assigned module -> Receive 204 revoke success -> GET /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/modules -> Receive updated module list
POST /api/v1/security/roles/{id}/permissions with a missing or invalid permission id -> Receive 400 validation error
DELETE /api/v1/security/roles/{id} for an existing role -> Receive 204 no content and soft deactivation -> GET /api/v1/security/roles/{id} -> Receive 404 or inactive record behavior

features.name: User Management
features.description: Creates user accounts, updates them, searches users, deactivates users, and assigns roles to users.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/security/users with valid user data -> Receive 201 created user -> POST /api/v1/security/users/{id}/roles with a role id -> Receive 204 role assignment success -> GET /api/v1/security/users/{id}/roles -> Receive 200 with assigned roles
GET /api/v1/security/users?username={username}&page=0&size=20 with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with matching users
PUT /api/v1/security/users/{id} with valid updates -> Receive 200 updated user -> GET /api/v1/security/users/{id}/roles -> Receive 200 with unchanged role assignments
DELETE /api/v1/security/users/{id} for an existing user -> Receive 204 no content and soft deactivation -> Attempt login with that account -> Receive 401 unauthorized response
POST /api/v1/security/users/{id}/roles with an invalid role id -> Receive 400 validation error or not found response
GET /api/v1/security/users without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response

features.name: Common Configurations
features.description: Stores shared runtime key/value configuration entries that can be created, searched, updated, fetched, and softly deactivated.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/common/configurations with configKey, configValue, and notes -> Receive 201 created configuration -> GET /api/v1/common/configurations/{key} -> Receive 200 with the stored value
POST /api/v1/common/configurations/search with filters -> Receive 200 with paginated configuration results
PUT /api/v1/common/configurations/{key} with updated configValue and notes -> Receive 200 updated configuration -> GET /api/v1/common/configurations/{key} -> Receive updated data
DELETE /api/v1/common/configurations/{key} for an existing configuration -> Receive 204 no content and soft deactivation
POST /api/v1/common/configurations with duplicate configKey -> Receive 409 conflict or 400 validation error
PUT /api/v1/common/configurations/{key} attempting to change configKey -> Receive 400 validation error because the key is immutable

features.name: File Categories
features.description: Maintains the taxonomy used to classify uploaded files and enforce file organization rules.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/files/categories with valid category data -> Receive 201 created category -> GET /api/v1/files/categories/{id} -> Receive 200 with category details
POST /api/v1/files/categories/search with category filters -> Receive 200 with paginated category results
PUT /api/v1/files/categories/{id} with valid updates -> Receive 200 updated category -> GET /api/v1/files/categories/{id} -> Receive updated details
DELETE /api/v1/files/categories/{id} for an existing category -> Receive 204 no content and soft deactivation
POST /api/v1/files/categories with invalid payload or duplicate business key -> Receive 400 validation error or conflict response

features.name: File Browser
features.description: Supports secure file upload, metadata retrieval, listing, token-based download, and archive or delete actions.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/files with multipart file and required metadata -> Receive 201 created file record -> POST /api/v1/files/{id}/access-token -> Receive 200 with short-lived download token -> GET /api/v1/files/download?token={token} -> Receive 200 with raw file bytes
POST /api/v1/files with missing required metadata or unsupported file type -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/v1/files/{id} with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with file metadata
GET /api/v1/files?ownerId={ownerId}&ownerType={ownerType}&page=0&size=20 with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with paginated file list
DELETE /api/v1/files/{id}?action=ARCHIVE for an existing file -> Receive 204 no content and archived status -> GET /api/v1/files/{id} -> Receive updated file status
DELETE /api/v1/files/{id}?action=DELETE with invalid id -> Receive 404 not found response

features.name: File Lookups
features.description: Provides runtime lookup values for the file module, including file statuses and other internal lookup sets.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/security/auth/login with valid credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token -> GET /api/v1/files/lookups/{lookupKey} with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with file lookup values
GET /api/v1/files/lookups/{lookupKey} with unknown lookup key -> Receive 404 not found response
GET /api/v1/files/lookups/{lookupKey} without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response

features.name: MDM Lookup Types and Values
features.description: Manages master-data lookup types and their values, including creation, search, retrieval, update, and soft deactivation.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/mdm/lookup-types with valid lookup type data -> Receive 201 created type -> POST /api/v1/mdm/lookup-types/{typeId}/values with valid value data -> Receive 201 created value -> GET /api/v1/mdm/lookup-values/{id} -> Receive 200 with value details
POST /api/v1/mdm/lookup-types/search with filters -> Receive 200 with paginated lookup type results
PUT /api/v1/mdm/lookup-types/{id} with valid updates -> Receive 200 updated type -> GET /api/v1/mdm/lookup-types/{id} -> Receive updated data
DELETE /api/v1/mdm/lookup-values/{id} for an existing value -> Receive 204 no content and soft deactivation
POST /api/v1/mdm/lookup-types/{typeId}/values with invalid parent type or malformed payload -> Receive 400 validation error or 404 not found response
DELETE /api/v1/mdm/lookup-types/{id} for an existing type -> Receive 204 no content and soft deactivation

features.name: MDM Lookup Consumption
features.description: Provides read-only access to active lookup values by lookup type natural key for consumption by other platform modules.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/mdm/lookups/{typeCode} with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with active lookup values under the active type
GET /api/v1/mdm/lookups/{typeCode} for an inactive or unknown type -> Receive 404 not found response
GET /api/v1/mdm/lookups/{typeCode} without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response

features.name: Notification Dispatch
features.description: Dispatches a notification across configured channels using templates and logs the result.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/notifications/dispatch with valid template and channel references -> Receive 202 or 200 dispatch accepted -> POST /api/v1/notifications/logs/search -> Receive 200 with dispatch log entry
POST /api/v1/notifications/dispatch with missing channel or template data -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/v1/notifications/dispatch with invalid recipient or payload data -> Receive 422 or 400 error response
POST /api/v1/notifications/dispatch with valid data but inactive recipients -> Receive dispatch accepted because inactive-recipient filtering is stubbed, then logs show delivery attempt

features.name: Notification Channels
features.description: Creates and maintains channel configurations used by notification dispatch.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/notifications/channels with valid channel data -> Receive 201 created channel -> GET /api/v1/notifications/channels/{id} -> Receive 200 with channel details
POST /api/v1/notifications/channels/search with filters -> Receive 200 with paginated channel results
PUT /api/v1/notifications/channels/{id} with valid updates -> Receive 200 updated channel -> GET /api/v1/notifications/channels/{id} -> Receive updated details
DELETE /api/v1/notifications/channels/{id} for an existing channel -> Receive 204 no content and disabled status
POST /api/v1/notifications/channels with invalid payload or duplicate key -> Receive 400 validation error or conflict response

features.name: Notification Logs
features.description: Allows operators to search and inspect notification dispatch logs.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/notifications/logs/search with filter criteria -> Receive 200 with paginated notification log results
GET /api/v1/notifications/logs/{id} with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with notification log details
GET /api/v1/notifications/logs/{id} with invalid id -> Receive 404 not found response
POST /api/v1/notifications/logs/search without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response

features.name: Notification Lookups
features.description: Provides runtime lookup values used by the notifications module.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/notifications/lookups/{lookupKey} with Bearer token -> Receive 200 with notification lookup values
GET /api/v1/notifications/lookups/{lookupKey} with unknown lookup key -> Receive 404 not found response
GET /api/v1/notifications/lookups/{lookupKey} without Bearer token -> Receive 401 unauthorized response

features.name: Notification Templates
features.description: Creates and maintains reusable notification templates, including optional attachment references.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/notifications/templates with valid template data -> Receive 201 created template -> GET /api/v1/notifications/templates/{id} -> Receive 200 with template details
POST /api/v1/notifications/templates/search with filters -> Receive 200 with paginated template results
PUT /api/v1/notifications/templates/{id} with valid updates -> Receive 200 updated template -> GET /api/v1/notifications/templates/{id} -> Receive updated data
DELETE /api/v1/notifications/templates/{id} for an existing template -> Receive 204 no content and soft deactivation
POST /api/v1/notifications/templates with invalid payload or missing required fields -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/v1/notifications/templates with attachmentFileId referencing a non-existent file -> Receive 201 or 200 accepted due to deferred validation, but downstream usage may fail

known_limitations.issue: TODO: XM-NOTIF-001 DEFERRED - DefaultRecipientStatusReader.isRecipientActive always returns true (stub), so notification dispatch never actually skips inactive recipients
known_limitations.impact: Notifications may be dispatched to inactive/deactivated user recipients

known_limitations.issue: TODO: XM-NOTIF-002 DEFERRED - attachmentFileId on template create is accepted without validation against the FILE module
known_limitations.impact: A template can reference a non-existent or inaccessible file ID

known_limitations.issue: TODO: XM-NOTIF-002 DEFERRED - attachmentFileId on dispatch request is accepted without validation against the FILE module
known_limitations.impact: A dispatch can reference a non-existent or inaccessible file ID

known_limitations.issue: PermissionController and UserController.search use GET with query params instead of the platform's standard POST /search contract
known_limitations.impact: Inconsistent API contract vs other search endpoints; documented deviation, not a defect

known_limitations.issue: ConfigurationController and ModuleController have no reactivation (activate) endpoint and no usage/reference-check endpoint, unlike most other master-data controllers
known_limitations.impact: Once deactivated, these resources cannot be reactivated via the API

known_limitations.issue: AuthController.logout lives under the public /auth path but is not public - it requires authentication, unlike its sibling endpoints
known_limitations.impact: Callers must be aware logout needs a valid Bearer token despite the /auth prefix

known_limitations.issue: No controller-level @PreAuthorize anywhere; all authorization is enforced one layer down in @Service classes
known_limitations.impact: Security review must trace authorization to the service layer, not the controller layer, to determine effective access control
